text:
ellie (partnerships): Quick sync — LangChain / LlamaIndex + Gateway pilot. Need alignment on: marketplace listing, co-announcement timing, hardware partner benchmarking, and orchestration smoke tests. TL;DR: pilot = connectors + sample app + marketplace bundle. Need signoff by next Tue. Thoughts?

devon (eng-ml): We can support LlamaIndex connector (v0.6) with our model variants. Need to validate KV cache behavior for long context workflows. Can someone share a canonical prompt set for evaluation? Also checking Dedicated GPU mem for batching :thinking: 

priya (product): I can own marketplace assets + PR draft. Do we want a joint blog + a small how-to quickstart with code snippets? Recommend both. Timeline: draft by Fri (May 8).

matt (solutions): For SI/partner playbooks, deliverables should include: deployment runbook, SSO/SCIM config, performance runbook, and a demo script. I'll sketch a checklist.

ellie (partnerships): Proposed launch cadence: soft listing on marketplace 2026-05-18, public blog 2026-05-25. Is that doable given testing?

devon (eng-ml): May 18 marketplace is OK if artifacts freeze by 2026-05-08. Need a simple testing matrix: models x seq-lens x batching. Quick smoke test I use below: 

```bash
# gateway smoke test
curl -s -X POST https://gateway.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-1.5-slim","input":"Summarize the following: <doc>","max_tokens":256}'
```

matt (solutions): Also verify LangChain adapter config. Minimal example: 

```json
{
  "adapter": "redwood-gateway",
  "use_cache": true,
  "model": "redwood-1.5-slim",
  "timeout_ms": 30000
}
```

priya (product): SSO/enterprise onboarding needs security OK. I'll loop eng-security. Also want SigmaCloud (hardware partner) to consider a benchmark badge for the marketplace tile.

ellie (partnerships): @sana (eng-security) can you confirm SSO/SCIM checklist? @jiao (partnerships) can you handle SigmaCloud comms?

sana (eng-security): On it. We'll need 3-legged OAuth + SCIM. Expect a 48h review on the initial config and a security checklist (token rotation, audit logging).

jiao (partnerships): Reached out to SigmaCloud; they requested perf numbers, a sample Helm chart, and a small test harness. Asked for dev cluster access — will update.

matt (solutions): I'll start a demo-app repo (simple LangChain pipeline -> Redwood Gateway) and share link by EOD Tue. Demo will include infra as-code (Helm) + a runbook.

ellie (partnerships): Action items: Priya = marketplace PR + assets, Matt = demo app + Helm, Devon = smoke tests + prompt set, Jiao = SigmaCloud follow-up, Sana = security signoff. Can everyone post a status update by EOD Thu? Thanks! :pray:

deploy-bot: Deployment note: sample-app pipeline build passed (ci-3782) — staging image available at ghcr.io/redwood/sample-app:pr-42-staging

devon (eng-ml): I'll upload a small prompt suite (10 cases) and perf matrix by Wed morning.

priya (product): Draft PR opened: https://git.redwood.ai/marketplace/pilot-langchain. Will add screenshots and blurb tomorrow.

matt (solutions): demo repo created: https://git.redwood.ai/demos/langchain-gateway-demo (WIP). Helm chart under charts/langchain-demo.

jiao (partnerships): SigmaCloud asked about target models and batch sizes. Suggested baseline: redwood-1.5-slim @ batch=8, seq=2048. They may run a perf matrix next week.

sana (eng-security): Quick note — we'll need a short privacy blurb for the marketplace tile about telemetry and logs. Priya, can you draft that section?

ellie (partnerships): Perfect. Last check — do we want a co-branded joint announcement with SigmaCloud on the blog day? If yes, we should draft joint talking points.

priya (product): Yes to co-branded. I'll draft talking points and share with SigmaCloud contacts.

devon (eng-ml): One small ask: test the LangChain memory + Redwood KV caching together (edge case for long dialogs). I'll add a failing-case to the prompt set.

matt (solutions): Noted. I'll wire that into the demo script.

ellie (partnerships): Thanks all — will reconvene Fri for final signoff unless blockers appear. :calendar:
